newsitem.title: UK: William Cook raises year profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: William Cook raises year profit forecast.

text.p: William Cook Plc, facing a hostile bid from engineering group Triplex Lloyd, has raised its pretax profit forecast for the year ending March 1997 to "not less than 11 million (stg)" in a statement issued at the weekend.

William Cook said the increase in its final dividend would be 10.25 pence per share taking the total to 13 pence per share. Total order output in the last quarter of 1996 was up 51 percent on the third quarter.
Orders at William Cook Parkway and Catton rose 34 percent and 16 percent, respectively, in the three months to December 1996.

The group added that "strong trading reflects new defence orders extending well into next year, higher than anticipated orders from mining machinery manufacturers and increased orders from the construction equipment sector."
The profit forecast does not account for an extra pre-tax profit of 500,000 stg from the sale of premises in Cleveland.
